description: Load housing on fixture and inspect bores
Press input-shaft bearing into housing
Press output-shaft bearing into housing
Install input-shaft oil seal
Press pinion gear onto input shaft
Install snap ring on input shaft
Press bull gear and key onto output shaft
Install spacer and snap ring on output shaft
Insert input-shaft assembly into housing
Insert output-shaft assembly into housing
Check gear-mesh backlash with dial indicator
Apply RTV sealant bead to housing flange
Place cover and run down 8 bolts
Torque cover bolts in pattern (DC nutrunner)
Install output seal and dust cap
Fill oil and fit breather and drain plugs
Pressure-decay leak test
Run-in and noise test
Apply label and final visual inspection
Pack into returnable tote
